findings: JDT BinaryIndexer indexes method declarations, field declarations and constant-pool references.
WorkspaceSymbolHandler delegates type searches to SearchEngine with WAIT_UNTIL_READY_TO_SEARCH.
Both systems perform upfront indexing and reuse persisted data. A type-only LSP result is not evidence JDT built a type-only index.
Historical JVMD readiness is measured inside the JVM; the new comparison additionally records parent-process readiness to include JVM launch.
